scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.e2e-dev.yml up -d
scripts.e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.e2e-dev.yml --profile test run --rm playwright
scripts.e2e:only: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.e2e-dev.yml --profile test run --rm playwright npx playwright test
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.e2e-dev.yml down
